description: Export a composition as a Motion Graphics template (.mogrt) (File > Export > Export As Motion Graphics Template) to the Local Templates Folder or a folder on a local drive. The file is named after the template name

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

folder.description: Absolute folder to save into. Omit for the Local Templates Folder (Essential Graphics templates)

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name. Default false

templateName.description: Set the template name (and file name) first. Default: the current template name, or the composition name

name: export_motion_graphics_template
title: Export Motion Graphics Template
